r: Utility to send raw CIM-XML request FILE to the a CIMOM and display the response/results. Default CIMOM is http://localhost:5988. If no input file is specified then get XML data from stdin. This used to be the wbemcatX utility before it officially replaced the original.

-t, --protocol=PROTOCOL
Protocol with which to connect. Default=http
-h, --host=HOSTNAME
Name of host running the CIMOM. Default=localhost
-p, --port=PORT
Port that the CIMOM is listening on. Default=5988
-?, --help
Display help message and exit.
